purpose: Three review-only grip and upper-body action-language candidates for the approved body and independent rifle before rigging, animation expansion, or runtime integration.
camera: one orthographic gameplay camera pitched downward exactly 45 degrees
facing: down-right three-quarter gameplay yaw, identical across all candidates
lighting: controlled cyan rim, restrained magenta identifiers, warm orange rifle core; no cinematic bloom
prompt: Using the approved Player A modeling sheet as the exact armored identity and the approved rifle orthographic sheet as the exact weapon identity, create three separate label-free action-pose sheets at the same orthographic 45-degree downward gameplay camera and down-right yaw. Every sheet contains idle-ready, moving, and firing key poses. The firing hand holds the pistol grip, the support hand wraps the forward handguard, the stock has a credible shoulder or chest contact appropriate to the candidate, wrists remain straight, elbows have armor clearance, trigger discipline is readable in non-firing poses, and the rifle never floats or rotates independently of the hands.
negative_constraints: no eye-level, horizontal, low-angle, perspective, dutch-angle, or cinematic hero camera
no one-handed rifle, crossed wrists, detached fingers, floating stock, broken elbows, extra limbs, fused gun, or yo-yo rotation
no identity drift, armor redesign, backpack removal, rifle redesign, scale drift, or different yaw between panels
no muzzle flash, smoke, recoil trail, text, labels, borders, floor, cast shadow, cropped anatomy, or background variation
no production animation, 120-frame atlas, Player.gd change, or claim of final rig approval

references.role: approved body identity, proportions, materials, armor, and backpack
approved independent rifle silhouette, proportions, and color placement
approved real body volume and measured gameplay-camera turn
YouMind 27303 long-rifle hand relationship and tactical armor composition only
YouMind 1620 two-hand load-bearing relationship only; its camera and style are explicitly rejected

candidate_outputs.focus: standard shoulder weld with balanced elbow clearance
compact CQB high-ready with a tighter silhouette
forward support-hand placement with a long aggressive brace

generation_model: built-in image generation tool plus local chroma-key removal and deterministic 64-pixel review scaling

runtime_evidence.alpha_report: all three 1254x1254 source sheets have transparent corners; deterministic extraction produced nine non-empty RGBA frames at 64x64

selection_approval.scope: standard shoulder weld and two-hand action language
